## Purpose

Describe the problem and the bounded change.

## Trust-boundary impact

- [ ] Financial state or money movement
- [ ] Contract authority or governance
- [ ] Attestation, evidence, or signatures
- [ ] SDK, API, event, or ABI compatibility
- [ ] Deployment or chain configuration
- [ ] No trust-boundary impact

## Verification

List exact commands and results. Include unauthorized, duplicate, replayed,
stale, out-of-order, and provider-failure cases when relevant.

## Release decision

- [ ] Backward compatible
- [ ] Requires a new immutable protocol version
- [ ] Requires independent security review
- [ ] Requires a new or updated deployment manifest
